did: Built the Rust Rounds week's flow on the phone, as you approved it: each ticket is read, worked in its academy, then voiced, every step one swipe of a single pager. Read shows what the week has to meet by id and the agent's options at each fork, one recommended; the academy lists its exercises and you tick one done at your desk; voice is the per-point take card with a pick at each fork, and a fork you leave alone goes with the recommended. The work tracker sits on every step and a closed week offers no new span. Then your decision at each fork goes home with the week sent, from server epoch 24; home's half is a patch the coordinator applies after RR23.

calls.title: What marks a step of a ticket's flow as gone through or skipped
options: Only the step's own button marks it; a swipe or the step row only moves
Every move forward marks the step left
Separate mark-done and skip buttons on each step
calls.why: Skipping is evidence the essay reads, so a swipe shouldn't write one by accident.
calls.undo: Change lib/flow's leave and the flow runtime's go to mark on a move (C710).

calls.title: Whether an exercise ticked as done at the desk can be taken back
options: A phone list that only grows, no untick
calls.why: Never losing the record favours a list that only grows, and sending ticks home is the tracker's story.
calls.undo: Add an untick record to lib/flow's tick and a lane in lib/kept-home (C712).

left: The six-theme captures were taken before the tick wording and the tracker's move onto the steps; they weren't retaken.
Copy main.rs and pasting rustc's output on an exercise aren't built: the week's ports have no clipboard.
Copy-to-chatbot (the study prompt, fork-aware) isn't built; it is a later step on RR25.
Exercise ticks stay on the phone until the tracker's story sends them home.
The Monday routine's record reader ignores the decisions home keeps; reading them into the essay is RR28.
Home's half of the decisions waits on the coordinator: apply the patch at epoch 24 once RR23 takes 23.
